core_obligations: Reduce to S = Spec(A) with E free on e_1, ..., e_n and write the matrix of F through F(e_i) = sum a_{ij} e_j (proof lines 4452-4455).

Prove surjectivity of F - 1: form the displayed algebra A' with n equations in n variables, note the differentials dx_i vanish so A' is unramified and quasi-finite over A, conclude A' is a global relative complete intersection hence flat and etale, obtain faithful flatness from the earlier Frobenius lemma, and exhibit the preimage of a given element (proof lines 4458-4483).

Prove constructibility of the kernel: the displayed quotient presentation represents Ker(F - 1) by a scheme affine etale over S, and the etale constructibility lemma concludes (proof lines 4486-4493).
proof_roadmap: Surjectivity of F - 1 via the etale covering algebra A' (proof lines 4458-4483).
Kernel represented by an etale scheme, hence constructible (proof lines 4486-4493).
